newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best affirms Pacific Mutual rating.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best affirms Pacific Mutual rating.

text.p: A.M. Best Co said it has affirmed the "A+", or superior, rating of Pacific Mutual Life Insurance Co and assigned the company's PM Group Life Insurance Co subsidiary a stand-along rating of "A+".
Previously, Best noted, PM Group's superior rating was consolidated with its parent company.

In addition, Best said, Pacific Corinthian Life Insurance Co had its Financial Performance Rating of "5" (average) affirmed. It is expected the company will be merged into Pacific Mutual Life late in 1997.
